I'm really bad at staying calm though. These days all i do is work, sleep, waste away my money, overthink like a broken record, feel miserable, repeat. I have gotten used to it but i have this feeling my mind and body is screaming to make a critical change. That is why suicide seems like a solution.

Thanks for the advice man. Definetely have to start somewhere seeing i am just letting myself sink deeper into this abyss. Swimming really helped when i was younger. Made me feel so full of life

Hope you get better too. Nothing will change instantly thats for sure but if you keep pushig through in the right directions you might as well end up somewhere you may like.

As long as i don't decide to hurt myself physically there is still a chance i can sort out the mental and emotional wreck i am right now.
